title: Mass. to be 4th state to roll out EBT chip cards to curb fraud
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Massachusetts will distribute new chip-enabled EBT cards statewide to prevent benefit theft, as announced by Gov. Maura Healey.
Approximately 1 million SNAP recipients in Massachusetts will receive the new cards, accepted at 5,500 authorized retailers.
The DTA tested the cards in Worcester, with transactions in thousands, and prepared retailers to accept chip or tap payments.

title: Boston is now offering ‘pet certificates’ for couples who wed at City Hall
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston City Hall now offers 'pet certificates' for couples who marry there with their pets present.
The certificate includes the City of Boston Department of Cuddles seal, recognizing pets as honored family members.
Mayor Michelle Wu launched the program, celebrating pets' role in commitment and family life.

title: Kevin Nealon discusses Conan, Dunkin’, SNL and more ahead of local shows
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Kevin Nealon discusses his New England ties and stand-up tour ahead of shows in Boston and Portsmouth.
Nealon emphasizes the role of social media in stand-up comedy and its impact on his career development.
His new comedy special 'Loose in the Crotch' is now streaming on YouTube's 800 Pound Gorilla Media channel.

title: Red Sox’ Willson Contreras leaves game after scary HBP vs. Dodgers
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox' Willson Contreras hit by 95 MPH pitch from Dodgers' Will Klein during Friday's game.
Contreras walked to first but was removed for precautionary reasons; Klein was also taken out of the game.
Red Sox manager Chad Tracy says Contreras underwent tests, is doing well but team awaits further updates.

title: After Patriots coaching stint, DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech staff
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech as assistant wide receivers coach after experience at Patriots training camp.
Hopkins, 34, praised for leadership and knowledge, bolsters Georgia Tech's coaching staff with NFL experience.
Patriots have another link at Georgia Tech with Vinnie Sunseri, a former New England support staff member.

title: Could Efton Chism and Kyle Williams both make the Patriots 53-man roster?
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Efton Chism and Kyle Williams are competing for spots on the Patriots' 53-man roster amid strong wide receiver performances.
The Patriots may face a tough decision with seven wide receivers vying for typically six roster spots for NFL teams.
Romeo Doubs and Kayshon Boutte are considered roster locks, complicating the situation for other receivers like Chism and Williams.

title: Reports: OF George Springer interested in trade to Red Sox, team eyeing INF Xavier Edwards
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Blue Jays outfielder George Springer is open to a potential trade to the Boston Red Sox before the deadline.
Miami Marlins infielder Xavier Edwards is drawing interest from the Red Sox for his versatility and base stealing.
Springer, 36, has shown strong performance at Fenway Park with a .323 batting average in 51 games played there.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' featuring Meryl Streep and Anne Hathaway is now streaming on Hulu.
'The Drama' starring Zendaya and Robert Pattinson streams on HBO Max, exploring social norms and cancel culture.
'Furious' Season 1 on Hulu follows Emmy Rossum as an FBI agent hunting a serial killer.

title: Here’s how home, away broadcasts reacted to Jarren Duran’s on-field flare-up
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Jarren Duran made headlines for his on-field reaction during the Red Sox's win against the Athletics.
Broadcasters criticized Duran for his visible frustration towards teammate Willson Contreras and coach Chad Epperson.
Reports suggest the Red Sox may trade Duran, who has been with the team since 2021, before the MLB trade deadline.

title: Drake Maye on building chemistry with A.J. Brown: ‘I am not going to shy away from him.’
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye and A.J. Brown develop strong chemistry during Patriots training camp.
Under tight coverage, Maye successfully targeted Brown, boosting their on-field connection.
Maye emphasized constant communication with Brown to improve their teamwork.
